Local legacy row models are readable source, not missing external contracts; modern models are treated only through visible bindings/writes. Zero/failure conversions and missing selection can create no query or a party-only query. XAML identifies legacy customer action as008, not007.

source_decisions.source_disposition: Store assignment does not clear all-stores; party type is judged against the actual loader, not method names. IO has conditional2-versus1 mismatch, POS2 differs from accepted picker1, legacy purchase/sale-purchase supplier2 is sent1. Modern purchase2, normal sale1 and contract23→1 are counterexamples. Party predicate additionally requires an actual selected client and !allClients.

source_decisions.counterevidence_and_limit: This is SQL text/control flow, not a query run or financial correctness/grain/as-of inventory certification. Header-versus-subprocess direction remains separately rooted P7-060.

source_decisions.source_disposition: Local activity result class/Tag carries display type and local number; fourteen Navigate sites span sixteen literal case labels/seven types, including adjacent alias labels. Queries omit branch/global/origin database. OpenForm/OpenWindow configure before Show; IO/Transfer core/reset and shared binders freshly read, other core evidence explicitly carried.

source_decisions.source_disposition: Fresh receiver/helper connections follow mutable global connstr rather than the caller cached connection. Branch/year/allowed-set is not part of LastProcess request or report row. Report and picker use their written UI/current-branch conditions; shared binder consumes caller query. MainClass WPF permission traversal returns on missing row and disables selected buttons, not data-row scope.

source_decisions.source_disposition: First picker has an early ISDone/key guard, but accepted first picker invokes BindingInvoice(ref parent) before second dialog. Second cancel replaces only the child field; no detached owned seed/snapshot rollback appears. All eleven parent sites call a void helper and perform branch-specific postwrites without an accepted result. Cancellation categories documented per site.

Existing P7-160 supported in parallel routes, not rewritten or considered remediated.

source_decisions.source_disposition: Purchase CheckBeforeClear No can stop void btnNew, but its outer linked caller always resumes into its branch; no guard result propagation. POS unsaved No returns before CLR, whereas password failure returns after CLR. IO/sale/contract linked paths have their actual preclear/guards described individually; contract guard existing elsewhere is not called by linked handler.
source_decisions.counterevidence_and_limit: Purchase refusal question is adjacent to P7-159, not declared same root or new numbered finding. No external dirty/setter/default proof and no complete D22 command exit.

source_decisions.source_disposition: Central binders mutate headers and add lines on the ref target; they can assign null on no row/outer failure and catch individual line errors. No clear-before-add or typed complete-hydration result. Helper catch can swallow dereference failure after binder and parent then resumes; null-check/Show/ISDone does not imply healthy complete load.
source_decisions.counterevidence_and_limit: The audit never executed SQL, reader, external setters or financial calculations. No provider failure, transaction atomicity, successful save or actual partial business invoice is certified.

source_decisions.source_disposition: Contract helper supplies child.invcontract after ref-binding InvContratct. Child InvType23 SQL branch exists, but selected writer/remover still operates inv.InvoiceItems. Helper ends with empty !ISDone branch and no contract result transfer; contract caller continues regardless. This refines carried R6C-CONTRACT-RESULT, not the last-row import P7-144 root.
source_decisions.counterevidence_and_limit: External model constructors/collections/alias behavior remain unproved; selected writer mismatch is visible without claiming exact runtime exception or financial loss. Further local contract Save/line ingress are not delegated to model owner.

source_decisions.source_disposition: Extended selected rows are mapped to every parent line by ItemId only; quantity/discount overwritten for each match, and removal uses ItemId set. RowNo, unit/store and source line identity are not used by selected-line writer. All-button bypasses selected-line rewriting. Legacy last-row import/duplicate roots are separately compared, not merged merely for shared ItemId.
source_decisions.counterevidence_and_limit: No new finding/novelty certificate with six original dictionaries missing. Remaining local unit/quantity/price/discount/VAT copy/merge intent and writers require separate decisions, not financial arithmetic executed in Python.

source_decisions.source_disposition: Reread picker maintains current-branch/type/process SQL and in-memory filter paths, including type20 OR purchase and original proc restriction. Return-button checks IsPreviousReturned; double-click/Enter have their own acceptance paths. Date/clear Cond rewrite remains existing P7-156. Eleven linked helper sites are not all direct picker callers.
source_decisions.counterevidence_and_limit: Raw key/ISDone is not full immutable DocumentRef/eligibility/allowed-set/healthy result. Enum support, deployed reference uniqueness, modal/chrome scheduling and remaining direct callers stay open.
